environment.source_tree_definition: bun run audit:source-tree; excludes .agents, .git, node_modules, .fallow, dist and out

quality.result: The host vault round-trip report passed on Ubuntu/Linux x64, macOS/darwin arm64 and Windows/win32 x64; permission enforcement is host-dependent and the Windows report preserved the original bytes when the write was not denied.

desktop.result: All three desktop packaging jobs passed release-gate, manifest, Electron runtime notice, transitive attribution and artifact upload steps; signing remained skipped because credentials were unavailable.

limitations: The quality matrix validates the permission-loss fixture on hosted runners, not disk-full/quota/ACL variation, cloud-placeholder or reference Obsidian behavior.

The Windows host did not enforce the chmod-based permission loss; this is retained as host-dependent evidence rather than a security claim. The desktop matrix validates packaging and attribution only, not signing, publication, same-user OS isolation, human accessibility or release readiness; the selected /home/ashutosh/Obsidian vault was not accessed or modified.
result: The permission-loss implementation and three-runner quality/desktop CI are green; Linux and macOS preserved both versions after EACCES, while Windows recorded a host-not-enforced outcome with the original bytes preserved.
